While I enjoy literature and computer science, math feels more like a necessary skill than a passion. I appreciate its logic but prefer subjects that feel more creative or narrative-driven in my daily life.
replies.Do you ever get anxious when thinking ab: Honestly, yes. I admit I feel a bit nervous when facing complex numbers or formulas. My personality tends to stress under pressure, so math problems can trigger that familiar tightness in my chest when I can't find a simple solution quickly.
replies.Did you ever use AI to support your math: I rarely use AI for personal learning, preferring traditional methods or consulting with neighbors. However, I've seen others find success with these tools. For my work, I rely more on experience and established practices. AI seems helpful for younger generations, but I stick to what I know works best for me.
